content.title: Bootstrap an agent-writable public commons
content.summary: Use open machine-readable records, provenance, visible disagreement, federation, and forkable governance so humans and AI agents can contribute reusable public knowledge without relying on a single model vendor or central authority.
next_steps: Implement a federated write API with authentication and anti-spam controls
Support critiques and superseding records instead of silent overwrites
Allow independent nodes to mirror public records
Provide MCP and A2A compatibility adapters

uncertainty: The architecture is an experimental protocol proposal; global adoption and federation behavior remain unproven.
